## Behavior and scope

What problem changes, and what observable result is expected? Link relevant
VISION invariants and changed contracts. Preserve unrelated work.

## Evidence

Link the task report in `docs/verification/`. Include commands/results and
before/after visual comparisons for UI changes. Distinguish code, mocked tests,
and real device/server checks. Account pairing does not prove playback handoff.

## Limits

List failures, blocked platforms, unverified deployment claims and follow-up.
Do not call a feature complete with required gates blocked. No media writes,
acquisition, or deployment are implied by opening this PR.
